claims.claim: GradMax grows a network during training by adding neurons.
GradMax does not disturb the learned behavior of the existing network when adding new neurons.
New weights in GradMax are initialized to maximize useful gradients through an SVD-based procedure.
GradMax improves training dynamics across several vision settings.
GradMax was presented at ICLR 2022 by Evci et al.

open_questions: How does GradMax compare to other dynamic network expansion methods in terms of final accuracy and computational cost?
What are the limitations of the SVD-based initialization when applied to very large models or non-vision tasks?
summary: GradMax introduces a method to grow neural networks during training by adding neurons initialized via SVD to maximize useful gradients, preserving learned behavior and improving training dynamics on vision tasks.
